text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-chan, happy birthday♪ And to 
celebrate~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! A present for you! I tried making 
some vinaigrette sauce.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Vinaigrette...? —Could it be, the dressing 
from that shop...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong! You got it! Hishi Ama-chan 
really liked that French place I 
recommended the other day, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I love that place too! After going there 
over and over... I finally managed to 
recreate their dressing recipe♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So I'm sharing it with you too, 
Hishiama-chan! I'll give you the recipe, 
so please use it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure...!? Giving me such a fruit 
of your hard work...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Delicious food is meant to be 
shared! I came up with a bunch of twist 
recipes too. Like seeing if it goes well 
with seafood poêlé or sautés~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
With that flavor, it'd probably be great 
drizzled over fruit too. It should mellow 
out bitter vegetables as well...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! My recipe research is gonna make 
some serious progress with this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Right? —Buuut! It's your birthday today, 
so let me treat you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I've prepared a special dish and recipe 
for you. You can taste-test it while we're 
at it, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Well now, this has turned into one 
luxurious birthday. Don't mind if I take 
you up on that, then!"
